summary:
JKAN, a static open data portal built with Jekyll, set up as the fictional "Westbrook Open Data" city portal. I saved 5 views, each opened directly by its URL with no further steps:
1) home (/): hero banner and grid of category tiles.
2) datasets-filtered (/datasets/?category=public-safety): searchable dataset list with category and organization filter sidebars, with the Public Safety filter turned on.
3) dataset-detail (/datasets/crime-incidents/): organization card, description, resources with format badges, and the Additional Info table.
4) organizations (/organizations/): department cards with logos and dataset counts.
5) organization-detail (/organizations/westbrook-police-department/): department page with a searchable list of its datasets.

Skipped:
- /categories/ looks almost the same as the category tiles on the home page.
- The category detail pages repeat the list layout.
- /editor/ only shows a CMS configuration error ("Error loading the CMS configuration"), so I couldn't reach the editor itself.
- The dataset page I checked had no resource "Details" toggles.
